scripts.build: npm run build -w @siteflow/shared && npm run build -w @siteflow/api && npm run build -w @siteflow/admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @siteflow/api --if-present && npm run lint -w @siteflow/admin --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @siteflow/shared --if-present && npm run typecheck -w @siteflow/api --if-present && npm run typecheck -w @siteflow/admin --if-present
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build:shared && npm run db:generate
